gallery.filename: Boulder City, Nevada from Flight Between Las Vegas, Nevada and Denver, Colorado (6780618265).jpg
gallery.title: File:Boulder City, Nevada from Flight Between Las Vegas, Nevada and Denver, Colorado (6780618265).jpg
gallery.artist: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
gallery.description:
Boulder City is a city in Clark County, Nevada, United States. It is approximately 20 mi (32 km) from the city of Las Vegas. As of the 2010 census, the population of Boulder City was 15,023. Boulder City is one of only two cities in Nevada that prohibit gambling, the other being Panaca.
Boulder City was originally built in 1931 by the Bureau of Reclamation and Six Companies, Inc. as housing for workers who were building Hoover Dam. In 2009, Money magazine ranked Boulder City 6th in its annual list of the top 25 places to retire in the United States, which was based on affordable housing, medical care, tax rates and arts and leisure.
